```
$ cat ./release.cfg; echo "--- exit=$?"; wc -c < release.cfg
version=1.4.2
--- exit=0
14
```

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Output | `version=1.4.2` |
| Exit code | 0 |
| Bytes | 14 (13 chars + newline) |
